# Sharah Kitab al-Tawheed — kitabattawheed.com

> Free Urdu audio explanation of Kitab al-Tawheed by Fazilat Shaikh Abdullah Nasir Rahmani Hafizahullah. 50 lectures across 15 classes (~27 hours). Stream online or use the Android app for offline listening and Study Mode.

## Primary content

- Home: https://kitabattawheed.com/
- All lectures: https://kitabattawheed.com/lectures/
- Search: https://kitabattawheed.com/search/
- Download Android app: https://kitabattawheed.com/download/
- About the series: https://kitabattawheed.com/about/

## Topic guides

- What is Kitab al-Tawheed: https://kitabattawheed.com/kitab-al-tawheed/
- What is Tawheed in Islam: https://kitabattawheed.com/tawheed/
- Sheikh Abdullah Nasir Rahmani: https://kitabattawheed.com/sheikh-rahmani/

## Catalog

- 15 classes (class-01 through class-15), 50 audio parts
- Lecture URLs: https://kitabattawheed.com/lectures/{class-id}/{part-slug}/
- RSS feed: https://kitabattawheed.com/feed.xml
- Content metadata: https://al-tawheed-content.pages.dev/tawheed/catalog.json

## App

- Google Play: com.almarfa.tawheed (Sharah Kitab al-Tawheed)
- Features: offline downloads, progress tracking, Study Mode, background playback, Urdu / Roman Urdu UI

## Contact

See app-config on CDN or the About page for support email.
